name: io.github.Venut-Technologies/serato-dj-mcp
title: Serato DJ library
description: Ask AI about your Serato library: harmonic search, crate audits, previewed crate building.

packageArguments.name: --library
packageArguments.description: Serato library folder, the one holding master.sqlite. Optional on macOS, where the library in ~/Library/Application Support/Serato and on mounted drives is found automatically.

packageArguments.name: --allow-writes
packageArguments.description: Flag, takes no value. Adds stage_crate, preview_changes, apply_changes and discard_changes, so new crates can be staged, previewed and written while Serato is closed. Off unless given.

packageArguments.name: --allow-raw-sql
packageArguments.description: Flag, takes no value. Adds run_sql: one read-only SELECT against a snapshot copy, with raw rows and full paths. Off unless given.

environmentVariables.name: SERATO_LIBRARY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Same as --library; --library wins when both are given.
